title: Mega-Sena draw 3054 results and the four-number wins in Alagoas
seoTitle: Mega-Sena 3054: Draw results and wins in Alagoas
subtitle: No ticket matched all six numbers, and the jackpot rolled over to R$ 70 million
excerpt: Mega-Sena draw 3054, held on Sunday (6), had no jackpot winners, rolling over to R$ 70 million, while 41 bets in Alagoas matched four numbers.
author: Daniele Morais
contentHtml:
The Mega-Sena draw 3054, held on Sunday (6) in São Paulo, did not register any ticket with all six numbers, causing the jackpot to roll over to R$ 70 million. This sparked great interest, especially due to the number of four-number matches in Alagoas.

Drawn numbers and no jackpot winners

The winning numbers drawn were 08, 17, 24, 43, 47, and 58. No bet across Brazil completed the combination, keeping the accumulated amount for the next draw.

Four-number matches in Alagoas

Forty-one bets from Alagoas matched four numbers, distributed across the Agreste, the capital, the North Coast, the South Coast, the Sertão, and the Zona da Mata regions. The prizes ranged from R$ 735.73 to R$ 7,357.14.

  • 2 bets in Arapiraca
  • 1 bet in Batalha
  • 1 bet in Boca da Mata
  • 1 bet in Cajueiro
  • 1 bet in Craíbas
  • 1 bet in Feira Grande
  • 26 bets in Maceió
  • 1 bet in Maragogi
  • 1 bet in Murici
  • 1 bet in Palmeira dos Índios
  • 3 bets in Porto Calvo
  • 1 bet in São José da Tapera
  • 1 bet in São Miguel dos Campos

How to bet and deadlines

A single bet, with six numbers, costs R$ 6 and can be placed until 8 p.m. on the day of the draw at lottery shops, on the Loterias Caixa website, or through the app. For draw 3054, the deadline was until 8 p.m. on Sunday.

Digital syndicate bets (bolões) have a deadline of 8:30 p.m., exclusively through the Loterias Online portal and the app.

Odds of winning

For a six-number bet, the chance of winning the jackpot is 1 in 50,063,860, according to Caixa. The odds vary depending on the number of numbers played.

Next draw

The next draw, 3055, will take place on Tuesday (8) starting at 9 p.m., with a live broadcast on the website and Caixa's YouTube and Facebook channels. The jackpot is estimated to remain around R$ 70 million.

With information from G1, Folha de S.Paulo.
